messages:
carol (Docs): Hey team — opened PR 8421 to update the KMS examples and migration guide. It swaps in the new key rotation flow and adds a sample CLI snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421
alex (Docs): thanks! assigning reviewers: @sam and @lee. are we good to run the docs preview now?
sam (Eng): I can review the tech bits but left a note — the sample CLI includes a real-looking key id. Security/legal usually wants placeholders.
lee (Security): yep please redact anything that looks like a customer key or ARN. also see our internal guidance: use `REDACTED_KEY_ID` or `example-key-123`.
maria (Legal): looping in — if the snippet references any customer-specific metadata or contract language we need to remove it. quick question: is the snippet pulled from prod logs or synthetic?
carol (Docs): it's synthetic but copied from a debug session. I'll replace with placeholders. can we get a hold for merge until legal signs off? want to avoid reverts.
alex (Docs): understood. CI is currently running — docs preview link: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/docs/preview/8421 (preview failing link-check)
deploy-bot: CI Status for PR 8421: link-check FAILED, markdown-lint PASSED, preview BUILD 1/1 
sam (Eng): link-check failing because of a dead external link in the migration guide section 2.2 — I flagged it in the PR comments with the exact URL.
carol (Docs): fixing the dead link and redacting the key now. will push a follow-up commit in a few mins.
lee (Security): after redaction, I'll do a quick sweep for any credentials or internal endpoints. should be fast.
maria (Legal): once redacted, send me the updated snippet. if it only uses placeholders i'm fine to approve. timeline?
carol (Docs): pushed commit 9a7f — replaced key id with `REDACTED_KEY_ID` and swapped external vendor link with the vendor's docs homepage. short excerpt below:
```
# example key usage
redwood kms encrypt --key-id REDACTED_KEY_ID --input "hello"
```

alex (Docs): thumbs up. re-running preview.
deploy-bot: CI Status for PR 8421: link-check PASSED, markdown-lint PASSED, preview BUILD 1/1, status: SUCCESS
lee (Security): scanned the commit — no issues found. LGTM from security. :white_check_mark:
maria (Legal): reviewed the snippet and the surrounding language. no contractual references left. LGTM from legal.
sam (Eng): I left a tiny nits comment about wording in the migration steps, otherwise good.
carol (Docs): addressed the nits in 9a7f -> 9b0c. requesting merge window: can we merge after 12:00pm PT today to avoid clobbering the release candidate?
alex (Docs): ok holding for the 12pm window. i'll merge after that if no regressions. pls ping here if any last-minute probs.
carol (Docs): thanks all. I'll follow up with a quick changelog entry and update the KMS FAQ. :sparkles:
